label: 影楼常用景别 (Studio Portrait Shots)

options.label: 面部特写
options.value: tight close-up portrait focusing on facial features and eyes, clean framing with minimal background distraction, high detail skin and expression emphasis

options.label: 胸像构图
options.value: portrait shot framed from chest up, balanced composition highlighting face, shoulders, and neckline, classic studio portrait framing

options.label: 七分身构图
options.value: medium-long shot framed from mid-thigh to head, cinematic cowboy-style framing, strong subject presence with partial environment context

options.label: 全身标准构图
options.value: full body portrait framing from head to toe, balanced proportions, feet fully visible, clean vertical composition suitable for studio outdoor shots

options.label: 环境人像中景
options.value: medium-wide shot placing subject within surrounding environment, subject still dominant while context supports mood and story

options.label: 环境人像大远景
options.value: wide establishing portrait with small subject relative to environment, strong sense of space and atmosphere, controlled composition for scale

options.label: 高角度俯拍
options.value: high-angle shot looking down at the subject, altered perspective emphasizing posture and environment, clean and intentional overhead composition
